screen.relics_addon.help:
Overview: switch the device on and watch its level, integrity, charge and main stats.
Batteries: RF charges from any FE charger or the charge slot; mana refills from magic mods or experience. Each battery has its own switch.
Upgrades: spend the points you earn per level.
Swarm (hives): give drones to Droplet, Barrage and Containment, which fight at once, and to the healers. A mode needs at least one drone per corner of its figure.
The line on the left is experience to the next level. Hold Shift over a device in any inventory to open this console.
